description: 소방청_울산시 재난별 화학물질 데이터 [fire, police and emergency services and disaster risk and hazard maps] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 소방청. 울산소방본부에서 제공하는 2020년 재난별 화학물질 데이터로서 재난화학물 등록일, 화학물질 영문명, 긴급구조 분류명, 긴급구조 규모명 등의 정보를 제공하는 데이터임. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 소방청. Its tags are 재난별 화학물질, 화학물질, 재난별 화학, 재난안전. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2022-11-25 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
